name: The Red Path
description: Rulan, the thin-smiling scout of the Scarlet Lotus, will not offer friendship without a token. She asks for three tributes from the souther sects' own gardens: a viper's fang from the bamboo sea, a venom gland harvested by hand, and a black lotus seed from the Five Poisons' own terrace. Bring them all — and do not ask what they are for.
